title: T2AG first-run answers
description: The field table for the first-run answers.json. Descriptions, enums and examples live here because standard JSON has no comments — putting them inside answers.example.json would stop it being valid JSON, and that file must be readable by json.loads as-is. Companion file: answers.example.json (valid JSON, real field shapes, carrying the example_only refusal marker).

example_only.description: Appears only in answers.example.json. t2ag_init.py explicitly refuses to consume a payload carrying this marker as true — an example value is not the student's confirmation. Do not put this key in a real answers.json (false would also work, but deleting it is cleaner).

nickname.description: What the student wants to be called.

weekly_time.description: Weekly time available and how it is distributed; free text.

goals.description: Non-empty list. The tool writes each item into the profile.

long_explanation_mode.description: How a multi-part long explanation is organised; the default "map first, then branch by branch" is map-first.

branch_confirmation.description: How the student wants to confirm before continuing.

aged_review_mode.description: How review of aged items is triggered.

existing_basis.description: Prior background; write "none" honestly if there is none.

current_difficulty.description: Optional information. When not provided, write "not provided" explicitly; never leave "to be filled in" (first_run.md step 3).

teaching_notes.description: Teaching notes; as above, write "not provided" when there are none.

exercise_hint_gate.description: The exercise hint gate. **The model must not choose this on the student's behalf** (first_run.md step 3).

learning_day_cutoff.description: The learning-day cutoff time, e.g. 04:00. Cycles are counted in learning days, not calendar days.

updated.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Write the real current date — carrying an opening reading across a session that crosses midnight mis-dates a whole batch by one day (P-0074).

agent_max_active.description: Optional. Concurrent-run ceiling including Main; must not exceed agent_pool_limit.

agent_parallel_startup.description: Optional. Whether the startup formation runs in parallel.

x-not-in-this-schema.teaching_language: **Deliberately absent** (ruling LV-2, 2026-08-18). The teaching language is confirmed with the student at first_run step 3, but the model writes it **directly into the profile frontmatter** after step 4; it does not travel through answers.json. "Helpfully" adding it to this schema would overturn that ruling — if it should change, re-adjudicate rather than patching it in here.
